visual.notes: Eight authored standing directions and eight four-frame walk cycles are available. Sitting, carrying, lying and computer-use poses are not authored yet. Directions are visual orientations: front means facing the camera; movement up on screen uses the back view.

idle.description: Front idle uses the five-frame idle strip; other directions use their authored standing frame.

head_pat.description: Reserved short interaction. Uses the current idle pose plus a conservative body bounce until a dedicated reaction clip exists.
